plain.li: [match,warm] We hoped one of you would ask, {WRITER}. The whole town is talking about it.
[match,warm,theirHightech] Your proposal went round the settlement in an hour, {WRITER}. Yes, and gladly.
[match,cordial] Our people have talked it over, and we agree.
[match,cordial,theirHightech] We have gone over the terms, and we agree. Our good wishes to the two of them.
[match,cordial,call] Our head has given it a hearing and says yes, {WRITER}.
[match,refusal,letter] We have no wish to bind our people to your colony this way. Do not take it as an insult, though some here meant it as one.
[match,refusal,theirHightech,call] I'm sorry, {WRITER}. Our council put it to a vote, and it was no.
[greetings,warm,tie:marriage] Our people think of yours as near neighbors now, {WRITER}, and we write back.
[greetings,cool,tie:marriage] Your letter came. All is well enough here.
[news,cordial,tie:marriage] Here is our news, from one people bound to another.
[help,warm,tie:marriage] What binds our peoples binds us to help, {WRITER}. You didn't need to ask twice.
[condolences,warm,tie:marriage] We grieve with you, {WRITER}. Our town mourns your loss too.
[warning,warm,tie:marriage] Thank you for thinking of us. We will warn you as readily, as bound peoples should.
[greetings,cordial,tie:marriage:theirs,theirLowtech] The town sends its greetings to {INLAW}, and its season's gift is on the road.
[greetings,cordial,tie:marriage:ours,theirHightech] {SPOUSEOF} has become one of our town, and asks after your colony often.
[match:wronged,theirLowtech] Our people do not forget what was done to one of ours. Remember that.
[match:wronged,theirHightech] What your colony did to one of ours is on our people's record, and it stays there.
[ward,warm,askward,theirLowtech] It is an honor to be asked. A youth of our town will come to learn from yours.
[ward,warm,askward,letter] Your letter was read out in town, and the youth we chose hasn't sat still since. They will come.
[ward,cordial,askward,theirLowtech] A youth of our town will come. Teach them well and feed them well, as we would one of yours.
[matchask,us,lowtech] Our two peoples could be bound by this, if yours are willing.
[matchask,us,!lowtech] Our colony would like to propose a marriage, and a bond between our peoples with it.
[matchtalk,them,theirLowtech] Who would speak for each people on the day?
[matchtalk,them,theirHightech] Who would sign for your colony, and who for us?
[wardbye,them,theirLowtech] My town will remember your colony's name.
[wardbye,them,theirHightech] I'll tell everyone at home what your colony taught me.
